request.state:
Icelandic original: „Þetta er minn uppáhalds staður því þetta er minn heima og fæðingarbær. Falleg tútsýni, fallegt sólsetur og svakalega fallegt að geta séð sjóinn þegar maður vaknar.“
English gloss: “This is my favorite place because it is my home and birthplace. Beautiful views, a beautiful sunset, and incredibly beautiful to see the sea when you wake up.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
